rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when things, styles, or people do not match or fit together.

example.english: This shirt and these trousers look incongruous.
example.traditional: 呢件恤衫同條西褲好唔夾。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 seot1 saam1 tung4 tiu4 sai1 fu3 hou2 m4 gaap3

rows.note: Use this especially when colours, shapes, designs, or other elements fail to harmonize.

example.english: These two colours look incongruous together.
example.traditional: 呢兩隻色擺埋一齊好唔協調。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zek3 sik1 baai2 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 m4 hip3 tiu4

rows.note: Use this for something or someone that feels out of place in its surroundings or a group.

example.english: He looks incongruous at the market in a suit.
example.traditional: 佢着住套西裝去街市，喺嗰度顯得格格不入。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 tou3 sai1 zong1 heoi3 gaai1 si5 hai2 go2 dou6 hin2 dak1 gaak3 gaak3 bat1 jap6
